  • Shipping complex booking experiences: Build personalized booking flows, including leveraging Google Maps APIs to support searching for properties via an embedded map view, developing a recommendation engine based on past reservations and orchestrating seamless payment collection to complete the full booking lifecycle.

  • Abstracting complex systems into packages: Modernize legacy reservations systems by creating Sierra packages that optimize querying and updating trips for customers across the board. You’ll be challenged to think deeply about how to orchestrate each step of these workflows to maximize efficiency while upholding reliability and accuracy.

  • Improving the capabilities of our built in integrations: Expand platform extensibility by introducing new capabilities to our existing integrations. An example is extending our MCP integrations to support MCP UI, which allows customers to dynamically host their custom UI resources on our embedded chat windows.

  • Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems.

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments.

  • A builder and tinkerer's mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship.

  • Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems.

  • Excellent communication skills—clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Excitement in the travel space and a genuine care for helping improve the guest experience as a whole. Our customers care deeply about their guests, and we carry that through what we build every day.

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

  • Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 


ABOUT THE TRAVEL, TRANSPORTATION AND HOSPITALITY TEAM

 - The Travel, Transportation and Hospitality (TTH) supports some of the largest airlines, hotel chains, rental car brands, cruise lines and travel tech companies in the world. Our customers are frontiers in the travel space, and are true thought partners in shaping our platform, helping reinvent what hospitality looks like in this new era. Our customers rely on us to not only deliver standout customer experiences, driving stronger growth in their business. 

 - Our TTH team is constantly pushing the bounds of what is possible within this industry and beyond. We help support our customers in the moments that matter — whether that’s proactively encouraging new bookings to prepare for exciting events, or helping guests rebook their flights or stays during times of distress. We help our customers maximize the lifetime value of their guests and build products to delight guests at every touchpoint.

 - We’re a small and scrappy team, and we support each other with any deliverables we have to meet. Every engineer on TTH is also a product-led thinker; every PM on TTH is tinkering and developing tangible prototypes; and every strategist on TTH is capable of owning an agent end to end. As a part of this team, you’ll set the standard on what it means to go beyond your role, and help build the travel industry of the future.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and deliver production-grade AI agents https://sierra.ai/blog/meet-the-ai-agent-engineer: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes—they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.

 - Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle https://sierra.ai/blog/agent-development-life-cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

 - Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups in Silicon Valley, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

 - Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.


EXAMPLE PROJECTS

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

 - Building innovative multimodal experiences: Spearhead cross-cutting initiatives, partnering with the voice and Experience SDK teams to bring to life embedded voice mode in mobile apps. This brand new product allows users to talk, tap and text with our agents all in a single view — unlocking communication through rich visualizations, and accuracy in input collection with chat, with the ease and efficiency of voice.

 - Shipping complex booking experiences: Build personalized booking flows, including leveraging Google Maps APIs to support searching for properties via an embedded map view, developing a recommendation engine based on past reservations and orchestrating seamless payment collection to complete the full booking lifecycle.

 - Abstracting complex systems into packages: Modernize legacy reservations systems by creating Sierra packages that optimize querying and updating trips for customers across the board. You’ll be challenged to think deeply about how to orchestrate each step of these workflows to maximize efficiency while upholding reliability and accuracy.

 - Improving the capabilities of our built in integrations: Expand platform extensibility by introducing new capabilities to our existing integrations. An example is extending our MCP integrations to support MCP UI, which allows customers to dynamically host their custom UI resources on our embedded chat windows.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems.

 - Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments.

 - A builder and tinkerer's mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship.

 - Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems.

 - Excellent communication skills—clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Excitement in the travel space and a genuine care for helping improve the guest experience as a whole. Our customers care deeply about their guests, and we carry that through what we build every day.


EVEN BETTER...

 - Language Fluency: Professional fluency in both Spanish and English.

 - Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

 - Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

 - Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

 - Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

 - Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 

About the Retail team

  • Sierra is partnering with a large and growing number of retailers - spanning apparel and beauty, grocery and big-box, home and auto, consumer services, marketplaces, and consumer technology. Our agents help millions of shoppers and members every day: tracking and returning orders, finding the right product, booking services, and resolving issues in each brand’s own voice.

  • Retail is also where AI agents go beyond support to generate revenue. From product discovery and personalized recommendations to cart recovery, win-back campaigns, and in-store support that turns unanswered store calls into visits and sales, our team is redefining what an agent can do for a brand’s top line - not just its cost line.

  • Join us to transform how the world’s most-loved consumer brands engage their customers - and help build technology that makes shopping more personal, effortless, and delightful for everyone.

What you’ll do

As an Agent Strategist, you own how Sierra’s AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer’s thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business.

  • Own the Agent Development Life Cycle. Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it’s the best version of itself in the real world. You’ll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome.

  • Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers’ executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there.

  • Partner with the customer’s working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch.

  • Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next.

Example projects

These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently:

  • Launch an order management agent for a national apparel brand — order lookup, cancellations, returns, and exchanges — then hill-climb containment and CSAT week over week.

  • Partner with Product to build a shopping agent that plugs into a retailer’s existing search and recommendation systems to guide product discovery — turning the support channel into a revenue channel.

  • Stand up an in-store support voice agent for a big-box or grocery retailer, answering the stock-check and store-info calls that largely go unanswered today and converting them into store visits and sales.

  • Design a booking, payments, and outbound agent for a consumer services brand operating hundreds of locations.

  • Help a marketplace handle order status and buyer–seller disputes at enormous scale.

  • Launch outbound campaigns — cart recovery, win-back, churn saves, and subscription renewals — across voice and SMS.

What you’ll bring

  • Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships.

  • Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast.

  • Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion.

  • Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes.

  • Genuine interest in Financial Services and improving the end customer experience. Experience in financial technology, implementations at financial institutions, working inside of these institutions or familiarity with financial services security and compliance requirements (fair lending, PII handling, etc.) are a strong plus.

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

  • You’ve been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

 - Build enterprise-grade AI agents: As an Agent PM at Sierra, you will be responsible for partnering directly with our engineers and customers to build and ship AI agents that handle thousands of customer conversations a day.

   - Discover and assess their requirements.
   
   - Prepare and present demonstrations of Sierra’s agent.
   
   - Address and overcome technical challenges in the business process by working with technical counterparts.
   
   - Develop and improve Sierra virtual agents to fit and anticipate our customers’ needs and business processes.

 - AI-related experience (experience with product development for AI agents a plus).

 - MBA or equivalent professional experience (while this is a product management role, you will have the opportunity to lean into broader business roles).

  • Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers’ executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there.

  • Partner with the customer’s working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch.

  • Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next.

Example projects

These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently:

  • Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers.

  • Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation.

  • Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples.

  • Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner.

  • Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week.

What you’ll bring

  • Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships.

  • Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast.

  • Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion.

  • Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes.

  • Genuine interest in Financial Services and improving the end customer experience. Experience in financial technology, implementations at financial institutions, working inside of these institutions or familiarity with financial services security and compliance requirements (fair lending, PII handling, etc.) are a strong plus.

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

  • You’ve been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

What you'll do:

  • Assist our Agent Development team with the planning, organisation and trade offs required to optimise the weekly deployment of multi disciplinary resources across different customers, agent builds and countries, including the timely and accurate maintenance of key systems that provide transparency and help the business make better decisions

  • Help define and scale the playbook for how Sierra designs, builds, evaluates, launches AI agents at large enterprises, including some of the less obvious areas needed to attend to the needs of these customers in each stage of this process

  • Work closely with Agent Strategist account leads to identify whitespace, prioritize expansion opportunities, and build repeatable motions that convert post-sale momentum into durable revenue growth.

  • Turn insight into action: Analyze complex datasets and translate findings across all aspects of the Agent Development organisation into clear, executive-ready recommendations that drive high leverage decisions and operationalize best practices

  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives that span Strategy, Product, Eng, Legal and Ops teams including partnerships relevant to Agent Development - driving alignment, timelines, and accountability

  • Build internal tooling with AI: Leverage AI-native tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to build lightweight internal systems, automate workflows, and create other operational leverage across Agent Development.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in management consulting, or strategy and operations at top-tier technology companies.

  • Translate ambiguity into clear execution. Decompose loosely defined security, risk, and compliance challenges particularly in emerging AI domains into structured programs, prioritized workstreams, and measurable outcomes.

  • Lead communication and alignment. Provide clear updates to leadership on program health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs; surface issues early and drive cross-functional alignment.

Who you'll work with

  • Engineering: Infrastructure, Data Platform and Agent SDK engineers to shape technical requirements, manage dependencies, and deliver resilient systems.

  • Security & GRC: Security engineering, risk, compliance, and privacy partners to align on threat models, control strategy, audits, and risk management in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.

  • Product and GTM: Product, Agent Development, and Sales to operationalize security commitments and respond to sophisticated customer and regulator expectations.

  • Legal: On security terms, third-party risk, and contractual obligations.

  • Executive Leadership: Senior leaders who rely on you for clarity, prioritization, and confidence in Sierra’s security strategy and execution.

  • Experience running security-focused technical programs in fast-growing SaaS or platform environments.

  • Strong technical fluency across cloud infrastructure, IAM, infrastructure as code, observability, secure CI/CD, and incident response.

  • Ability to execute through ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and keep teams moving.

  • Comfort operating in environments where things aren’t fully built yet and helping decide what needs to be built first.

  • Clear, concise communication with senior technical and business leaders.

  • A collaborative, pragmatic style with high ownership and high agency.

Even better...

  • Experience scaling security programs globally in AI-first or data-intensive SaaS environments.

  • Exposure to emerging AI risk, data governance, or agent and model-related security considerations.

  • Experience supporting security initiatives in public-sector, regulated and/or multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure).

  • Relevant security, cloud, AI or technical program management certifications.

  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, HIPAA)

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 

About the Retail team

  • Sierra is partnering with a large and growing number of retailers - spanning apparel and beauty, grocery and big-box, home and auto, consumer services, marketplaces, and consumer technology. Our agents help millions of shoppers and members every day: tracking and returning orders, finding the right product, booking services, and resolving issues in each brand’s own voice.

  • Retail is also where AI agents go beyond support to generate revenue. From product discovery and personalized recommendations to cart recovery, win-back campaigns, and in-store support that turns unanswered store calls into visits and sales, our team is redefining what an agent can do for a brand’s top line - not just its cost line.

  • Join us to transform how the world’s most-loved consumer brands engage their customers - and help build technology that makes shopping more personal, effortless, and delightful for everyone.

What you'll do

  • Architect Sierra's most complex deals: Lead our largest multi-BU, multi-geo opportunities, designing sophisticated deal structures and managing risk with precision and conviction.

  • Operate as part of the customer's team: Hold trusted relationships across the customer C-suite and working teams.

  • Engage at the founder level: Be trusted to regularly engage and manage Sierra's co-founders in front of customers, pitching with co-founder-like conviction and expertise.

  • Bring precision to everything: Operate with exacting craft in messaging, positioning, and timing across every interaction.

  • Shape strategy: Influence how Sierra approaches its most important accounts and set the standard for the broader sales org.

  • Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.

What you'll bring

  • 10-12+ years of enterprise/strategic sales experience, owning the largest and most complex accounts.

  • Demonstrated success closing multi-million-dollar, multi-stakeholder deals spanning business units and geographies.

  • Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

  • Deep, sustained C-suite relationships and the gravitas to be treated as a peer by executive buyers.

  • Mastery of complex deal structuring, risk navigation, and pricing.

  • Exceptional executive communication and a reputation for precision and trust.

Even better...

  • Deep familiarity with the AI landscape and the ability to speak credibly to technical and business stakeholders alike.

  • Experience operating alongside founders/executives in front of strategic customers.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 10-12+ years of enterprise/strategic sales experience, owning the largest and most complex accounts.

 - Demonstrated success closing multi-million-dollar, multi-stakeholder deals spanning business units and geographies.

 - Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

 - Deep, sustained C-suite relationships and the gravitas to be treated as a peer by executive buyers.

 - Mastery of complex deal structuring, risk navigation, and pricing.

 - Exceptional executive communication and a reputation for precision and trust.


EVEN BETTER...

 - Deep familiarity with the AI landscape and the ability to speak credibly to technical and business stakeholders alike.

 - Experience operating alongside founders/executives in front of strategic customers.


OUR VALUES

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Design and deliver production-grade AI agents: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth.   • Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

  • Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale.   • Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.

Example projects

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

  • Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development

  • Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers

  • Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

  • A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship

  • Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems

  • Strong English and Korean communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

  • Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

  • Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

  • Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders

  • Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples.

  • Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner.

  • Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week.

What you'll bring

  • Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships.

  • Communication. Strong English and Korean communication skills. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast.

  • Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion.

  • Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes.

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

  • You've been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

  • Own the CRM data model and operational infrastructure for partnerships, including partner records, account mapping, workflows, reporting, data quality, and automation

  • Identify bottlenecks across the partner lifecycle, from opportunity assessment and commercial design through launch and ongoing management, and build scalable solutions

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner on portfolio strategy, new partnership opportunities, and the programs or incentives most likely to drive measurable partner-led growth

  • Hands-on experience with CRM and reporting tools; able to define data requirements, build trusted reporting, and improve the systems and workflows teams rely on

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance growth, partner value, operational complexity, and financial sustainability

  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving alignment across GTM, Finance, Legal, Product, and senior leadership

  • A highly structured, detail-oriented approach, paired with the ownership and flexibility to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment

  • Experience supporting strategic alliances, channel partnerships, marketplaces, or other partner-led revenue motions

  • Experience with outcome-based, usage-based, or consumption pricing and the forecasting challenges those models create

  • SQL proficiency and experience with BI tools, Salesforce, or partner relationship management platforms

  • Experience building a Revenue Operations, pricing, or partner operations capability from the ground up in a high-growth AI or SaaS company

  • Experience supporting complex global partnerships across multiple regions and commercial models

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

  • The Retail team on Agent Engineering supports some of the largest and most storied consumer brands in the world – including Gap, Wayfair, Sonos, and ADT.   • Our team supports our customers’ customers in the moments that matter – whether that's guiding a shopper to the right product during a limited drop or a Black Friday surge, locating a package that never arrived, or troubleshooting an appliance that stopped working.   • Our team supports our customers' customers in the moments that matter most, from product discovery and checkout to order tracking and troubleshooting. Always true to each brand’s voice, we create seamless experiences that resolve issues, drive revenue, increase lifetime value, and build lasting loyalty.

What you’ll do

  • Design and deliver production-grade AI agents: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. About us

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 

About the Tech, Media & Telecom team

  • We work with some of the world's most influential and recognizable companies, from global telecommunications providers and leading media brands to technology platforms that power businesses worldwide.

  • We build agents for the moments that matter, helping our customers rise to the occasion when service disruptions, major product launches, or global events like the World Cup drive millions of customer interactions.

  • We bring Sierra’s Horizon vision to TMT by building agents that transform the entire customer relationship:

    • Telecommunications: Turn one of the most frustrating customer experiences into one of the most personal, with agents that understand each subscriber, optimize their plan and savings, anticipate opportunities to add value, and earn their loyalty over time.

    • Media: Turn every subscription into an ongoing, personalized relationship, with agents that help each subscriber get the most from their experience through the right content, offer, plan, and support from their free trial through retention.

    • Technology: Bring the white-glove customer experience traditionally reserved for the largest enterprise accounts to every customer, helping them adopt the product, discover new ways to get value, expand their usage, and successfully renew.

What you’ll do

  • Design and deliver production-grade AI agents: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes—they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.

  • Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

  • Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups in Silicon Valley, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

  • Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.

Example projects

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

  • Create agents that pursue goals over weeks and months, reasoning about when to reach out, which channel to use, and what next action will move a customer relationship forward.

  • Develop personalization and experimentation systems powered by Sierra's Context Engine that combine customer data, behavior, prior conversations, and real-time context to determine the right offer or experience, then learn from every interaction and experiment to autonomously improve personalization over time.

  • Design conversational discovery agents that reason across huge content catalogs and rich subscriber context, using interests, history, entitlements, and the moment at hand to help someone quickly find something they'll actually want to watch, read, or listen to.

  • Build agents that troubleshoot deeply integrated telecommunications and connected-device experiences, reasoning across account, billing, network, and device systems to diagnose issues and take the actions needed to resolve them.

  • Experiment with new voice experiences and Voice Personas tailored to each brand, customer, and moment, bringing the right empathy, energy, and conversational style to everything from navigating a frustrating telecom billing issue to helping someone discover their next favorite show or find the plan that's right for them.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems.

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments.

  • A builder and tinkerer's mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship.

  • Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems.

  • Excellent communication skills—clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Excitement in the Tech, Media & Telecom space and a care for helping some of the world’s top brands continue to build brand loyalty with their customers.

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

  • Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

  • Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

  • Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

  • Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

What you’ll do

As an IT Support Specialist in New York, you'll be the hands-on, on-the-ground owner of day-to-day IT for one of our fastest-growing offices. You'll be the first person teammates turn to when something isn't working, and the person who makes sure hardware, conference rooms, and the office network simply work. This is a role for someone who thrives in execution mode and enjoys solving problems quickly and efficiently. Your responsibilities will include:

  • IT Support: Serve as the first line of defense for employee IT issues in New York, with deep focus on macOS troubleshooting, application support, and network connectivity.

  • Global Support Queue: Share responsibility for Sierra's global IT helpdesk queue during your regional working hours: triage new requests, resolve issues across offices, keep ownership clear, coordinate escalation, and provide clean cross-time-zone handoffs.

  • Technical User Support: Support engineers and other highly technical teammates with curiosity and confidence, using logs, command-line tools, and clear written communication when appropriate.

  • AI-Assisted Troubleshooting: Use approved AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate research, hypothesis generation, and documentation while protecting sensitive data and independently validating consequential recommendations.

  • Hardware Management: Own the full device lifecycle locally—procurement, deployment, inventory tracking, loaner pool oversight, and device re-provisioning for offboarded users.

  • AV & Conference Rooms: Keep every room meeting-ready. Maintain and troubleshoot conference room AV, proactively test rooms, and own the peripheral and accessory inventory.

  • Office Build-Out & Moves: Partner with Facilities, our project managers, and AV integrators to spec, stage, and commission IT and AV for our new New York space, and support the move from our current location.

  • Network & Vendor Coordination: Triage office network and connectivity issues, then drive them to resolution with our ISP, network, and building vendors.

  • IT Onboarding: Set up laptops and essential software for new hires, delivering a seamless first-day experience.

  • SaaS Administration: Handle routine administration in Okta, Google Workspace, and other core applications, including users and groups, app assignments, access changes, licensing, and basic audit-log review.

  • IT Projects: Take on well-scoped endpoint, SaaS, access, inventory, or workplace technology projects with clear success criteria, appropriate review, testing, documentation, and rollback planning.

  • Process Improvement: Look beyond the immediate ticket, respectfully challenge inefficient or fragile practices, propose practical improvements, and help implement and document better ways of working.

  • IT Logistics: Support software installs, device shipments to East Coast teammates, repair and warranty coordination, and proactive hardware refresh planning.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience: 2-5 years in hands-on IT support or systems administration, with strong macOS experience in a fast-paced or startup environment.

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfort with endpoint management and MDM systems (e.g., Jamf), identity tooling (e.g., Okta), and troubleshooting across Mac hardware and software.

  • SaaS Foundations: Hands-on experience with basic Okta, Google Workspace, or comparable SaaS administration and a desire to grow into broader systems ownership.

  • Engineering Environment: Experience supporting engineers or other highly technical users, or clear evidence that you can communicate credibly, work from technical evidence, and learn unfamiliar systems quickly.

  • Troubleshooting Judgment: A structured, hypothesis-driven approach; strong follow-through; and the judgment to recognize uncertainty, seek review, or escalate before a risky change.

  • Queue Ownership: Able to manage competing requests in a shared global queue, communicate priorities, maintain accurate status, and carry issues through resolution or a clear handoff.

  • Continuous Improvement: Curious about why work is done a certain way and comfortable constructively challenging the status quo with specific, practical recommendations.

  • AV & Network Fluency: Practical troubleshooting of conference room AV and office networking fundamentals—Wi-Fi, DHCP, VLANs—and the judgment to know when to escalate to a vendor.

  • Organization: Highly organized with a systems-oriented mindset—able to track devices, accessories, and inventory accurately across multiple offices.

  • Execution Focused: Bias for action and the ability to troubleshoot, solve problems, and follow through without constant direction, while knowing when to seek review or escalate.

  • Communication: Friendly, clear communicator who can help teammates quickly and patiently—whether they're in-office or remote.

  • Work model: This role is based in our New York office, with in-office work Monday through Thursday and remote work on Fridays.

Even better…

  • Experience supporting an office build-out, relocation, or new-site commissioning from the IT and AV side.

  • Familiarity with Zoom Rooms and hardware such as Neat, Logitech, or Poly.

  • Past experience with Apple Business Manager or zero-touch deployment tools.

  • Passion for documentation, process improvement, and enabling others to solve simple issues themselves.

  • Change-Control Exposure: Familiarity with version control, peer review, staged rollout, rollback planning, infrastructure or configuration as code, or other disciplined change practices.

  • Automation: Experience using APIs, scripts, Terraform, or similar tools to make routine administration safer and more repeatable.

Our values

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

 - SaaS Foundations: Hands-on experience with basic Okta, Google Workspace, or comparable SaaS administration and a desire to grow into broader systems ownership.

 - Engineering Environment: Experience supporting engineers or other highly technical users, or clear evidence that you can communicate credibly, work from technical evidence, and learn unfamiliar systems quickly.

 - Troubleshooting Judgment: A structured, hypothesis-driven approach; strong follow-through; and the judgment to recognize uncertainty, seek review, or escalate before a risky change.

 - Queue Ownership: Able to manage competing requests in a shared global queue, communicate priorities, maintain accurate status, and carry issues through resolution or a clear handoff.

 - Continuous Improvement: Curious about why work is done a certain way and comfortable constructively challenging the status quo with specific, practical recommendations.

 - AV & Network Fluency: Practical troubleshooting of conference room AV and office networking fundamentals—Wi-Fi, DHCP, VLANs—and the judgment to know when to escalate to a vendor.

 - Execution Focused: Bias for action and the ability to troubleshoot, solve problems, and follow through without constant direction, while knowing when to seek review or escalate.

 - Communication: Friendly, clear communicator who can help teammates quickly and patiently—whether they're in-office or remote.

 - Work model: This role is based in our New York office, with in-office work Monday through Thursday and remote work on Fridays.


EVEN BETTER…

 - Experience supporting an office build-out, relocation, or new-site commissioning from the IT and AV side.

 - Familiarity with Zoom Rooms and hardware such as Neat, Logitech, or Poly.

 - Past experience with Apple Business Manager or zero-touch deployment tools.

 - Passion for documentation, process improvement, and enabling others to solve simple issues themselves.

 - Change-Control Exposure: Familiarity with version control, peer review, staged rollout, rollback planning, infrastructure or configuration as code, or other disciplined change practices.

 - Automation: Experience using APIs, scripts, Terraform, or similar tools to make routine administration safer and more repeatable.


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 

About the Public Sector team

  • Sierra recently received FedRAMP High certification, enabling us to bring our industry-leading technology to partners in the US public sector. We’re now building our founding public sector team to redefine the relationship between the government and its citizenry.

  • Today, our agents already enable citizens to access social services, report fraud, and understand complex government systems. Simultaneously, they empower government officials to better hear the concerns and inquiries of their constituencies.

  • We are explicitly nonpartisan and committed to empowering public servants to leverage AI to advance their important missions.

  • In our journey, we are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

What you’ll do

As an Agent Strategist, you own how Sierra’s AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer’s thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business.

  • Partner with working teams day to day. Run working sessions with program, operations, technology, security, legal, and procurement stakeholders; resolve issues as they arise; and make the decisions that keep deployments moving toward launch.

  • Identify new ways to expand our impact. Understand our partners' most urgent needs and develop roadmaps for new use cases, including proactive outreach, multilingual access, and long-horizon agents that can support people across multi-step journeys.

  • Directly shape the product and our public sector strategy. Surface unmet needs from customer work, prototype new approaches, and partner with research, product, platform, and public sector leadership to influence Sierra's roadmap, market strategy, and repeatable solutions for government.

  • Make critical reporting easier and safer. Build trusted conversational experiences for reporting fraud, safety concerns, or other high-stakes issues while meeting rigorous privacy, security, accessibility, and auditability requirements.

  • Enable proactive government services. Create a roadmap for outbound agents that remind people about deadlines, explain program changes, or help them complete important next steps before a benefit or service is interrupted.

  • Build repeatable public sector capabilities. Use a live agency deployment as a design partnership to shape new platform capabilities, evaluation standards, or implementation patterns that can serve institutions across federal, state, and local government.

  • Technical aptitude. Comfort engaging directly with technical concepts, including reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering and security tradeoffs in design discussions.

  • Commitment to public service. A passion for public sector work and a belief in the potential of institutions to improve outcomes for the people and communities they serve.

  • Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive communication across executive, operational, policy, and technical audiences, with the ability to turn complexity into shared decisions.

  • Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as policy, stakeholder, or implementation conditions change.

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

  • Experience working in or with federal, state, or local government, including familiarity with procurement, security and compliance, accessibility, policy implementation, or systems integration.

  • You’ve been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful.   • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - In our journey, we are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build enterprise-grade AI agents for government institutions: As an Agent Product Manager at Sierra, you will partner directly with our engineers and public sector customers to build and ship AI agents that serve people across high-stakes, mission-critical interactions. These agents will help constituents navigate complex programs, complete important tasks, and get timely, trustworthy support while meeting the security, accessibility, and reliability standards government work demands.

 - Discover where agents can make the greatest impact: Ground-up discovery is a critical part of the role. Work closely with federal and state institutions to understand their missions, operating constraints, constituent needs, and service-delivery workflows. Identify and prioritize new opportunities for AI agents to improve access, responsiveness, and outcomes.

 - Engage with customers at every level: Become a trusted advisor to public sector leaders and a hands-on partner to their working teams. Discover and assess requirements, prepare and present demonstrations, navigate technical and operational challenges with customer counterparts, and continuously improve agents to fit each institution’s policies and workflows.

 - Own outcomes from concept through production: Translate mission goals into a clear product strategy, roadmap, and measurable definition of success. Coordinate across customer stakeholders, engineering, design, research, security, and operations to take agents from initial concept through launch and ongoing iteration.

 - Shape the platform and public sector roadmap: Your direct work with government institutions will guide the evolution of Sierra’s core platform. Surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform teams to shape the future of AI agent development for the public sector.

 - Help build Sierra’s public sector business: Partner closely with public sector leadership on market strategy, product investments, and repeatable approaches that allow the team to scale quickly while preserving the trust and craftsmanship our customers expect.


EXAMPLE PROJECTS

These are examples of projects our healthcare team has worked on:

 - Build agents that help people understand eligibility, apply for benefits, check case status, and navigate complex social-service programs.

 - Develop secure reporting experiences that make it easier to report fraud, waste, abuse, or other concerns and route each submission appropriately.

 - Create voice and chat agents that answer questions about licenses, permits, taxes, public records, and other high-volume government services across languages and channels.

 - Design proactive and long-horizon agents that keep constituents informed, collect missing information, and guide them through multi-step government processes over time.

 - Turn patterns in constituent conversations into actionable insights that help public officials understand emerging needs and improve service delivery.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5-7+ years of experience developing highly technical products.

 - Experience in Product Management or a similar product development role at or above the level of Senior Product Manager.

 - A passion for public sector work and a belief in the potential of our institutions to transform outcomes for the people they serve.

 - Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs, navigate complex organizations, and solve real-world problems. A core part of the role is coordinating directly with public servants and technical stakeholders to understand their workflows.

 - Experience crafting and tailoring messages for different audiences, including senior executives and public sector leaders.

 - Ability to communicate highly technical concepts to both non-technical and technically proficient audiences, including recent developments in AI.

 - Strong product judgment and a track record of driving ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from discovery through launch and measurable impact.

 - A degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent professional experience.


EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience building or deploying AI/LLM products, especially conversational or long-horizon agents, and familiarity with evaluation, retrieval, prompt engineering, or agent tooling.

 - Experience with government technology or working with public sector institutions, including an understanding of procurement, regulation, security, accessibility, and patterns of partnership.

 - A demonstrated track record of operating in ambiguity, for example as part of a founding team, a new initiative within a large organization, or a forward-deployed product or engineering team.

 - Some coding experience with React, TypeScript, and Go, or experience prototyping technical products directly with engineers.

 - An MBA or equivalent professional experience at the intersection of technology, operations, and strategy.

 - Past roles that involved working directly with end customers to influence software development.


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.
